    "Recomputed all seven current core/production-footprint metrics and 47 current workload metrics across ten workloads against registered hashes, methods, units, counts and limits; all pass.     "I reaffirm the version 4 acknowledgment for cold process launch of an already assessed installed copy. Current installed-copy cold p95 is 387.832 ms and warm p95 406.433 ms. First-copy p95 remains 5104.155 ms, maximum 5494.141 ms, separately recorded. This does not establish sub-two-second first-install behavior; the supplied XProtect diagnosis was not independently reproduced.",
    "Native workflows use staged v1 data, fixture Keychain items and synthetic loopback services. Current canary scans show no seeded secret/content hits; startup/reconnect samples include the app and three newly appeared WebKit processes, with zero sockets and unsolicited reconnect requests. Sampling can miss short connections, pre-existing shared WebKit processes and DNS attribution. Real-profile/login-Keychain qualification remains C25, physical power loss was not tested, and no pinned vulnerability-advisory scan is claimed. Signing, notarization, installed-package and update/rollback qualification remain C26; this pass covers P07."
